title: Setup: build Spring Boot #51959 (S37) at both pins and run its landed tests
description: Setup job for llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief.md, case S37 (spring-projects/spring-boot#51959: JUL records still reach the logging backend after a test context resumes). In the worktrees $P/worktrees/S37-{fix,parent} (P = ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-boot-pr-links-s01-s50), offline (dependencies resolved online beforehand), it builds the jars of core:spring-boot with the Gradle each checkout's wrapper names on JDK 25, runs the landed test classes (LoggingApplicationListenerWithContextPausingTests (test) ) at the fix and those of them that exist at the parent, keeps the jars, SHA256SUMS (jars and every class of the changed production sources) and the runtime and test runtime classpaths of core:spring-boot core:spring-boot-test in $P/artifacts/S37-ROLE, then runs the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent, where they are expected to fail or not compile, and removes the build trees. Script: $P/scripts/case_job.sh. No claims, no verifier.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent BUILD SUCCESSFUL with failures=0 errors=0 for the landed classes; transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE-AS-EXPECTED; clean prints cleaned S37

resources.notes: Gradle daemon -Xmx3g with the Kotlin compiler in process, plus test JVMs; buildSrc and gradle/plugins compile once per worktree and once in the transplant copy (about 1 min each)

steps.name: S37 fix: build and landed tests
S37 parent: build and the parent's tests
S37 transplant: the fix's tests on the parent
